data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=HVH9cgQ6xQYQ7kNvgFus2JT&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDc-jzZUsVajMgxXSPbq29cosVLKu03mdgvYmHcwzXdmA&oe=6710F59C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mUHkjG0Mzz8Q7kNvgFavQf6&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDL95VYdcMcKWJjeehKTXI606ur9EH3iZ51s-VZEC-vtA&oe=6710FF24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=3c79JJXGIGsQ7kNvgEm6ylN&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCdP1G7ANmZvURq0iJ3AlZ0TMEMdZ4V3WydmtfcQlRp2A&oe=6710E687)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=-4Yz_ibvxVEQ7kNvgEHvOuK&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA510xI5Qbi6mKRRRhi8nVYZfkea2JmUXgnz4_X9bzTww&oe=6710D966)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=SH7uytqQgOgQ7kNvgFdLIG2&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDSVZ1aPgy7va8K7QkYBzc3wVfL6RuwQ7rAltovKLBPRw&oe=671105D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=EjDVxvsu07UQ7kNvgEHw3hz&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAm1Ge8K9KiI1tLIKYXpw_Ipicj2v14-f7ATZyk0vU7BA&oe=67110259)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=kflrnZjHRvgQ7kNvgEnqerH&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDLA748etJMjHPvCDZL5JJ2Ha7xlBP04TfoPppaylWqJg&oe=6710E870)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_BFcdTED0BUQ7kNvgH3I7Yb&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBraz2AjoDr3Iyuh6ADgDBjGb6-rsoNP7CNNPw5uR7H6A&oe=67110B2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=KIgdx6GhGFYQ7kNvgEYa0nZ&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBRkvHSRmE_h758yJ0jpNio6thO5sZRYvOj97EmaKTaCA&oe=6710E697)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=0XTwq6Dr7isQ7kNvgFKXbp7&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC6sJoRP_Vid5O4nSeUWMwWALeQesBZNqoKuL3WshnLPQ&oe=6711020C)
